entries.name: Rick Springer

expected.charges: Charges arising from April13,1992 anti-nuclear disruption of Reagan speech; initial arrest episode
expected.sentence: 120 days imprisonment for interference with the Secret Service.

updates.sentence: 120 days imprisonment for interference with the Secret Service. Initial detention April 13-14, 1992 ended with release on personal recognizance. The later service of the sentence and failure-to-surrender term are recorded separately.

entries.rationale: Contemporary April 14 UPI report explicitly states judge freed Springer Tuesday on his own recognizance. Completes initial one-day detention and preserves the intervening bail gap.

entries.name: Rick Springer

expected.charges: Interference with Secret Service and failure to surrender; subsequent prison term
expected.sentence: An additional 11 months imprisonment for failure to surrender.

updates.sentence: An additional 11 months imprisonment for failure to surrender. Actual confinement August 9, 1993-September 9, 1994 covered the later prison term following the original offense and failure to surrender. The court identifies August 9 as an arrest, not voluntary surrender. This exact interval replaces the rounded thirteen-month total; time on bail after April 1992 is excluded.

entries.rationale: Appellate opinion supplies August 9, 1993 arrest; contemporary interview reports thirteen months served and September 9, 1994 release. Verified original journal printed page 26. Existing rounded counter becomes an exact interval; not counted as a newly working counter.
